country.evidence_quote: Childline is a free and confidential service for children and young people in the United Kingdom. It provides support online and by phone, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, for anyone under the age of 19. Children and young people can contact Childline about any concern, big or small, and receive advice, support or a listening ear.
